speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the update. To better understand your history of gait and limb ataxia, could you describe exactly how your walking has changed over time? Additionally, have you experienced any changes in your vision or sensation in your hands or feet?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That description of looking "drunk" while walking suggests significant cerebellar involvement. Have you noticed any slurred speech, difficulty swallowing, or double vision accompanying these motor issues? Also, do you have a history of alcohol use disorder or previous head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Natalizumab-induced Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
